items.author: superzero11 <https://github.com/superzero11/uiset>
items.name: uiset
items.title: UISet
items.description: The UISet root: skins, a key color, and sound and haptics for every UI SDK component inside it.
items.docs: Wrap your app, or any part of it, in <UISet skin="base"> from @/components/ui/uiset. Pass keyColor={{ l: 0.5, c: 0.19, h: 268 }} for the accent, sound to turn interaction sounds on, and skin="blueprint", "studio", "phosphor" or "ink" for a themed skin (each names the faces it uses in the README). Every UI SDK component inside is styled by the skin.
